visual.general_description: Four panels: three stained tissue sections at increasing detail and one immunohistochemical stain.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A to D form a 2 by 2 grid with white panel-letter boxes at the lower right of each panel. Panel A is a low-power section with epidermis and a cellular dermal infiltrate. Panels B and C are higher-power sections of swirling oval to spindle cells separated by pink collagen. Panel D is a tan-brown immunostain with blue nuclei. Each panel has a white scale bar at the lower left whose text is unreadable.

panels.general_description: Low-power hematoxylin-and-eosin-type section with epidermis above and a cellular dermal infiltrate below.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is a low-power pink-and-purple stained section. A thick undulating purple epidermis with a thin detached surface layer lies across the top. Below it the dermis is filled with a densely cellular pale purple infiltrate with swirling and streaming pink collagen bands. A white scale bar with text too small to read lies at the lower left. The panel letter A is in a white box at the lower right.
